name: The Spooktacular New Adventures of Casper
s: The Spooktacular New Adventures of Casper is a 1996–1998 animated television spin-off of the feature film Casper , which, in turn, was based on the Harvey Comics cartoon character of Casper the Friendly Ghost

paragraphs.text: The Spooktacular New Adventures of Casper is an American animated television spin-off series and a sequel of the feature film Casper, which, in turn, was based on the Harvey Comics cartoon character of Casper the Friendly Ghost.
